discovery.ranking_note: No new ranking was computed for this export.

insights.summary: Silicone did not sustain flame spread in these tests

values.title: Silicone did not sustain flame spread in these tests
values.evidence: This occurred in all four silicone specimens.
values.meaning: The observed behavior was limited under this combination of airflow, oxygen, pressure and specimen geometry.
values.why_it_matters: Provides evidence for material comparisons; it does not certify all silicone configurations as safe.

insights.summary: Flames spread over both SIBAL fabrics

values.title: Flames spread over both SIBAL fabrics
values.evidence: Published rates were 2.1 mm/s at roughly 20 cm/s airflow and 2.6 mm/s at roughly 25 cm/s.
values.meaning: The second rate was 23.8% higher. This is a comparison of two tests, not a universal airflow law.
values.why_it_matters: Identifies a relationship worth testing with more ventilation and propagation experiments.

insights.summary: A flame can advance slowly while burning persists for minutes

values.title: A flame can advance slowly while burning persists for minutes
values.evidence: The PMMA slabs have published burn durations of 10 and 15 minutes, with flames near the leading edge.
values.meaning: Limited advance and extinguishment are different outcomes.
values.why_it_matters: Fire-safety analysis must also consider how long burning persists.

insights.summary: The composite's PMMA burned, but Nomex did not ignite

values.title: The composite's PMMA burned, but Nomex did not ignite
values.evidence: Only one specimen used this combination.
values.meaning: The fire did not transfer from the PMMA section to the Nomex section in that test.
values.why_it_matters: Provides a material comparison case that needs replication under other conditions.

insights.summary: Each test needs its own CO2 baseline

values.title: Each test needs its own CO2 baseline
values.evidence: Pre-test readings ranged from approximately 3307 to 4334 ppm.
values.meaning: The tests started at different CO2 levels, so each response subtracts its own initial reading.
values.why_it_matters: Avoids attributing CO2 already present to the current test.

insights.summary: The model improved one specific prediction in a small pilot

values.title: The model improved one specific prediction in a small pilot
values.evidence: Its mean absolute held-out error was 17.83 ppm.
values.meaning: It estimates the three-minute sensor change within this pilot; another flight is needed for external validation.
values.why_it_matters: Provides a first tool for comparing predicted and observed responses.

insights.summary: The data are closer to the assumed ISS and Gateway scenarios

values.title: The data are closer to the assumed ISS and Gateway scenarios
values.evidence: The tests used near-terrestrial pressure, airlike oxygen and microgravity.
values.meaning: They more closely match those reference scenarios used in the relevance comparison.
values.why_it_matters: Helps prioritize which evidence to consult for a given environment.

insights.summary: Transfer to lunar, Mars and rover environments remains unvalidated

values.title: Transfer to lunar, Mars and rover environments remains unvalidated
values.evidence: The local archive has no enriched-oxygen, low-pressure or lunar/Martian partial-gravity tests.
values.meaning: Comparisons with those habitats are indicative and use analyst design assumptions.
values.why_it_matters: Identifies additional experiments needed before extrapolating.

insights.summary: Smoke signals alone cannot establish alarm timing

values.title: Smoke signals alone cannot establish alarm timing
values.evidence: Alarm events, thresholds and verified clock synchronization are missing.
values.meaning: A reliable detection delay is unavailable for each test.
values.why_it_matters: Identifies the information needed to evaluate detection equipment.

assumptions: Nominal specimen geometry follows postflight matrix except preflight 10mm nominal for grooved PMMA
Material inheritance for empty II-6 and II-9 cells and 037-to-0.37 correction are documented
Electrical pulse defines t=0; optical ignition time may differ
One-second medians and fixed windows reduce unequal-cadence and duration effects
CO2 percent to ppm multiplier 10000; PSIA to kPa multiplier 6.894757293168; mW/cm2 to kW/m2 multiplier 0.01
No published numeric spread value is represented as an independently calculated value
Habitat atmospheres are analyst design scenarios

data_quality_flags.message: Some historical originals are absent. Local derived files and recorded provenance remain available.

interpretation_limits: Nine test records in one flight; no independent flight validation or randomized replicates
Model selected by repeated LOOCV; reported best error has selection optimism
A single PMMA-Nomex composite test cannot validate material-specific generalization
Material, geometry, sample location, flow and ignition energy are confounded
Only two quantitative published spread rates; no independently calibrated optical-front extraction
Sensor offsets and mixing dominate some small CO2 responses; negative changes are not physical CO2 consumption
Uncertainty describes window variability, not absolute sensor accuracy or a confidence interval
No CO, acid gas or particle-mass channels and no applicable exposure/alarm thresholds
Cygnus clock alignment is unverified; mission telemetry cannot be assigned to per-test alarm delays
No HRR from oxygen consumption without paired channels/mass flow or validated cabin mass balance
No controlled ventilation cutoff or extinguishment effectiveness measurements
No enriched-O2/low-pressure or lunar/Martian partial-gravity experiments in this archive
Rankings use illustrative analyst atmosphere assumptions and subjective weights, not mission requirements
Reported damage length, fuel regression, flame tip and pyrolysis propagation are different physical quantities

reading_guide.measured: Recorded by an instrument; retain its calibration and uncertainty limits.
reading_guide.published: A value reported in the original NASA or published reduction.
reading_guide.calculated: Derived from recorded conditions or measurements, not a model prediction.
reading_guide.predicted: A saved model estimate; validation and scenario predictions are separate.
reading_guide.null: Unavailable or not applicable; never interpret as zero.

charts.title: Observed CO2 response and model error
charts.description: Left: signed CO2 changes for the nine tests. Right: baseline and selected-model RMSE; lower is better.
charts.interpretation_note: CO2 change is not a hazard score. Error reduction is not an accuracy or safety percentage.

charts.title: CO2 comparison windows
charts.description: Each panel shows baseline-subtracted CO2 over time. Gray marks the pre-ignition window; orange marks 150-180 seconds.
charts.interpretation_note: The shaded regions define the calculation windows, not exposure limits.

charts.title: Published SIBAL spread rates
charts.description: Two published flame spread rates plotted against measured pre-ignition airflow.
charts.interpretation_note: Two observations do not establish a causal or universal airflow law.

charts.title: Temperature sensor coverage
charts.description: Maximum sampled plume-thermocouple readings and duct inlet temperature for each test.
charts.interpretation_note: Different sensor positions and coverage prevent interpreting these as maximum flame or average cabin temperatures.

charts.title: Sampled camera frames
charts.description: Three camera frames per test, selected near 30, 90 and 150 seconds after the electrical marker.
charts.interpretation_note: Visual quality control only; no independently calibrated flame-front measurement.

charts.title: Saved cross-validation predictions
charts.interpretation_note: Separate targets, scales and validation groups.

charts.title: Existing processed sensor series
charts.interpretation_note: Units are retained in channel names and source analysis.

autoresearch.target_justification: CO2 response at a fixed 180 s horizon is measured in all nine tests. One row per ignition avoids treating correlated frames as replicates. Only two published SIBAL spread rates exist; HRR and alarm delay lack required channels/calibration.
autoresearch.target_definition: median of 1-s CO2 medians at [150,180) s minus median at [-30,0) s; ppm; electrical ignition reference; signed sensor response
